scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic; monic irreducible sextic models counted, not curve isomorphism classes. The genuinely assessed extension is the arithmetic Richelot quotient splitting/odd-degree point-count classification and exact q=3,5 Weil-polynomial histograms. No general frequency formula for larger q or converse to odd-degree balancing. Some historical priority sources remain unindexed or incompletely accessible.
title: Quadratic-induction Richelot strata of irreducible genus-two sextics and their first Weil spectra
